references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Charging wedge silhouette; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 legs catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 legs splay and bend to catch weight; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied leg support; not repeated standing duplicates. Keep FOUR animal feet and natural creature anatomy, no rearing, no human arms. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description. CORRECTION: The previous sheet was rejected as nearly static. Make the head and shoulder mass jerk BACK by one head length for the flinch. For heavy stagger bend the forelegs deeply, twist the entire shoulder mass backward 25 degrees and splay the feet to catch lost balance; then rise and recover. Four feet, rear anatomy retained, head toward upper right. Must be a visibly struggling creature, not standing duplicates or walking. Match exact faceted GREY stone slab palette and blue seams of Reference-2, not smooth green cartoon hide. Ten small complete separate poses.

arguments.Prompt:
Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy game animation sprite sheet on solid uniform pure vivid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). 

GRID ARRANGEMENT:
A clean 5 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet containing exactly 10 separate poses of the creature, evenly spaced with wide empty magenta gutters between cells. Each cell contains exactly one full body at identical anatomical scale, positioned within the center 60% of each cell. No grid lines, no borders, no labels, no numbers, no floor plane, no ground shadows, no background scene.

CHARACTER IDENTITY & STYLE:
Pure quadruped beast (animal only, no human limbs, no clothes, no weapons). Heavy, squat, broad quadruped stone beast with a wedge silhouette, blunt mineral horns, small armored head, heavy blunt feet, angular thorn-like stone plates projecting along its back, faceted grey stone slab armor, glowing blue illuminated mineral seams and ochre cracks running through the stone body. Match the lighter stylized painterly values, sculpted geometric volumes, cool upper-left lighting, and palette from Reference-1.png and Reference-2.png.

PERSPECTIVE & CAMERA:
High 55-degree orthographic elevated angle. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter perspective (facing northeast / diagonally away and toward the upper-right). The camera views the beast from behind-and-to-the-side, showing back surfaces, rear spine plates, flank, and back legs throughout all poses. The creature never turns to face the viewer.

10 HIT REACTION POSES (5 columns x 2 rows, reading left to right):
Row 1:
- Column 1 (Pose 1): Ready stance. Quadruped rear-right view, head and torso facing upper right, stable grounded stance.
- Column 2 (Pose 2 - Quick Flinch Recoil): Head and heavy shoulder mass visibly jerk backward by one head length away from the impact, torso compressing back.
- Column 3 (Pose 3 - Quick Flinch Catch): Forelegs plant to absorb shock, torso rebalancing.
- Column 4 (Pose 4 - Quick Flinch Recover): Body resets back to balanced ready stance.
- Column 5 (Pose 5 - Heavy Stagger Ready): Tense ready pose before major impact.

Row 2:
- Column 1 (Pose 6 - Heavy Stagger Recoil start): Abrupt violent recoil, front of body snaps backward.
- Column 2 (Pose 7 - Deep Stagger Peak Recoil): Deep hunched violent recoil with lost balance; entire shoulder and spine mass twisted backward 25 degrees, head thrown back, forelegs buckling.
- Column 3 (Pose 8 - Heavy Stagger Foot Splay): Forelegs bend deeply and splay wide to catch falling stone weight, rear legs bracing.
- Column 4 (Pose 9 - Heavy Stagger Rise): Powerful push upward from splayed forelegs, shifting mass forward.
- Column 5 (Pose 10 - Stagger Recovered): Fully recovered and stable quadruped ready stance.

Clear distinct hit reaction poses showing visible struggle, body compression, and weight shift. Consistent anatomical scale across all 10 sprites.
